answers.core: Improving the import workflow out of the box.
answers.workaround:
No it isn't possible to do it with lines of script.
I have to for example import each object on its own using a separate .blend file.
And then rebuild the whole level in Godot 

Instead of making the level in blender and directly import it.

Which also makes tweaking the level visuals take some time or more steps.

title: Import meshes as instanced scenes instead of duplicating them when using `.blend` import
